items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I recollected a lot of guys, Dick Hyfer and some of the other guys, and I started -- now, this is funny. We're booked as an eight piece band... I kept adding men. And this guy got on the phone to MCA and he said, 'What are you doing? I signed a contract for eight men.' He said, 'Barnet just walked i

ctx.x: For about the umpteenth time. I started out with a -- I started out with, I think it was about eight men. Let's see. Yeah. And we came down here to San Diego here, and we opened in a place that's no longer there. And Neal Hefti wrote all the charts and Frances Wayne was back singing with me. And we played a bunch of places around. We were here, we spent about six weeks here, and got the thing together, and then we were booked around. We played a whole bunch of one nighters in Arizona and New Mexico, and on up in

the great northwest. In the meantime I had forgotten that I had a return clause engagement with Bop City, and they were insisting on it. And I flipped. I turned -- I was screaming on the telephone and they said, 'Well, you can take your choice. You can bring the little band in or you can come in with the big band, but you're going to come in.' And I thought, well, I can't go in there with a little band, you know, I mean after that other band. So Ray Wetzel was still with me. He was in the trumpet section. And I…
